# New Client Onboarding Workflow
# Documentation-style process definition. Defaults chosen in lieu of
# client-specific requirements; adjust owners/SLAs as the process matures.

workflow:
  name: new_client_onboarding
  version: 1.0.0
  status: draft
  description: >
    Standard onboarding process for new clients, from signed handoff
    through kickoff with the delivery team.
  trigger:
    type: manual
    description: Sales hands off a signed client to the delivery team.
  steps:
    - id: intake
      name: Client intake & document collection
      owner: Account Manager
      sla_days: 3
      description: Collect company details, key contacts, and required documents.
    - id: contract
      name: Contract signing & billing setup
      owner: Account Manager
      sla_days: 5
      description: Finalize contract via e-signature and create the billing record.
    - id: provisioning
      name: Account / system provisioning
      owner: Operations
      sla_days: 3
      description: Create accounts, grant access, and configure environments.
    - id: kickoff
      name: Kickoff meeting & handoff
      owner: Engineer
      sla_days: 5
      description: Schedule kickoff, align on timeline and success criteria, hand off to delivery.
  notifications:
    enabled: false
    channels: []
    recipients: []
